description:
PySpark dataframe mode fails on 13 TPC-H queries due to missing methods in the
UnifiedExpr class. The queries use Polars-style expression APIs that are not
translated for PySpark.

Error messages observed:
- 'UnifiedExpr' object has no attribute 'is_in'
- 'UnifiedExpr' object has no attribute 'str'
- 'UnifiedExpr' object has no attribute 'dt'
- 'UnifiedExpr' object has no attribute 'filter'
- 'UnifiedExpr' object has no attribute 'n_unique'
- object of type 'DataFrame' has no len() (Q11 - ctx.scalar issue)

Affected queries: Q2, Q7, Q8, Q9, Q11, Q12, Q13, Q14, Q15, Q16, Q19, Q20, Q21, Q22
